subtitles.text: That doesn't look like a star...
Is it just me, or are they moving?
Wait. Are they coming this way?
Something is wrong. Look at them!
I have no signal on my phone.
Oh my god, it's taking him!
I can't move... I can't move!
They're not going to get me!
It's... it's sweeping the light across us!
Oh my god... they just... they just vanished.
They don't care about us... they're just looking.
Another one... it's lighting up everything!
Something is coming down in the light...
Why isn't he moving?! What did you do?!
Let him go! Let him go!
They're picking us off one by one!
